item.title: “Spoke to Virat about…”: R Ashwin hits back at social media troll over indirect attack accusation
item.description: Ravichandran Ashwin on Thursday (January 29) hit back at a social media troll after the latter accused the former India spinner of indirectly targeting Virat Kohli while analyzing India's third T20I win over New Zealand in Guwahati. item.description: Pakistan men’s cricket team, led by Salman Ali Agha, will fly to Sri Lanka for the T20 World Cup 2026 next week. item.title: Mumbai players compelled to sport face masks in Ranji Trophy fixture against Delhi due to pollution: Report
item.description: Mumbai's players were compelled to wear face masks to protect themselves from pollution caused by construction on the first day of their Ranji Trophy fixture against Delhi on Thursday (January 29).
